author: Yffe
content: Run verus in a per-run scratch DIRECTORY removed WHOLESALE (RAII Drop guard), so the .rs source + verus's ~4.3M compiled-binary sibling + any artifact all go away on EVERY exit path incl. a ? early-return. Single file forge/src/check.rs: add struct ScratchDir + Drop (best-effort remove_dir_all, R-CODE-2); unique_temp_path -> unique_scratch_dir (dir, pid+counter, R-CODE-5); run_verus writes <stem>.rs (no-. crate_stem, gotcha intact) inside it; invoke_verus runs verus with current_dir = scratch dir. Class check: kani.rs already removes its crate dir wholesale (no leak); vacuity_solver.rs shares the leak but is off-manifest -> report for follow-up. Regression test forge/tests/scratch_cleanup.rs: success + error paths, isolated TMPDIR, no surviving forge_* entry; skip-loud if verus absent.
